Limitations: Real TheEndGame.Update/Draw readiness observed; no readiness flags, retained buffers or scene frames injected.
Timing includes the normal rendering/preparation path on this machine; this is a bounded switch proof, not an FPS benchmark.
Unavailability counts measure Draw callbacks with _deckReadyForInput=false; synchronous work can delay a callback without adding an unavailable frame.
World simulation is paused and input suppressed; presentation animation clock remains natural.
Textures retained by unchanged renderer objects were inspected before and after; this does not instrument every filesystem open.
